title: Bitmomo BTC Intelligence — Analyst Input Package (Reconciled V1)
description: One package built once per run, filtered per-analyst before being sent to any of the 11 analysts. Reconciled 2026-08-26 against the real, merged source of class-bitmomo-ai-binance.php: most fields below now map directly to that live snapshot rather than a from-scratch fetch. See docs/ai/DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md for the full field-by-field EXISTING/REUSE vs MISSING/ADD classification.
x_reconciliation_note: Fields marked '(existing)' in their description are already computed live by Bitmomo_AI_Binance::snapshot(). Fields marked '(missing/add)' are confirmed absent from PR #7 and require new work, with cost noted. Nothing marked 'existing' should be re-fetched or re-derived independently -- reuse the live snapshot output.

schema_version.description: Semver of this schema, e.g. "1.1.0". Bumped from 1.0.0 for this reconciliation pass (fields added/split).

package_id.description: Unique id for this snapshot, used as the storage key for historical validation.

freshness.description: (existing, needs normalization) The live engine reports one combined 'quality' block (status/completeness_pct/data_age_minutes/optional_missing), not three separately-aged fields as originally drafted. Normalize by using the single data_age_minutes value for all three below unless/until the engine is extended to age-track derivatives and flow independently.

timeframes.description: Price/structure data per timeframe. 'trend_state' here is the EMA20/EMA50 + breakout signal (existing: structure.state / structure.state_1d) -- deliberately kept separate from the ADX-based 'direction' block below; see 'Duplication removed' in DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md for why these were not merged into one field.

direction.description: (existing) Maps directly to snapshot() 'direction' block -- ADX/DI-based, distinct from timeframes[*].trend_state. New top-level block added by this reconciliation; the original schema had no place for this real, live field.

structure.description: (existing, richer than originally designed) Maps to snapshot() 'structure' block, including the operational support/resistance system (confirmed-pivot + ATR-guarded) not present in the original design. New top-level block added by this reconciliation.

funding_rate_recent_avg.description: (existing, renamed) carry.funding_7d -- actually the mean of the last 21 8-hour prints (~7 days), not a distinct '8h avg'. Renamed from the original 'funding_rate_8h_avg' to avoid implying a second window that doesn't exist.

oi_zscore.description: (existing, not in original design) crowding.oi_zscore -- adopted because it's already computed live.

global_long_short_ratio.description: (existing, not in original design) crowding.global_long_short_ratio -- adopted because it's already computed live, Bybit fallback included.

data_status.description: (existing) carry.data_status -- records whether Binance or the Bybit fallback actually served this run's derivatives data.

liquidation_data.description: Deliberately null for V1. Confirmed: neither Binance nor Bybit (checked during this reconciliation) offers a reliable free historical REST liquidation endpoint -- both are websocket-only. See DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md.

perp_volume_24h.description: (existing) derivable from the already-fetched futures klines volume field.

spot_volume_24h.description: (MISSING/ADD) Spot klines are currently fetched only as a failover when the futures call errors, not in parallel every run -- so this field is not reliably available today. Requires one additional standing Binance spot klines call per run (same free/no-key tier already in use). Not required until that fetch is added.

taker_buy_ratio_spot.description: (MISSING/ADD) Depends on the parallel spot-klines fetch above; once added, this is pure computation from the existing 'taker buy base asset volume' kline field, no new endpoint. Not required until that fetch is added.

cross_market.description: (MISSING/ADD, unchanged) Confirmed absent from PR #7 -- no CoinGecko or market-cap source anywhere in the plugin.

dxy.description: Deliberately null for V1 -- no reliable free source. See DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md.

event_context.description: (MISSING/ADD, unchanged) Text entries from a manually-curated event calendar. Confirmed nothing like this exists in PR #7.

source_metadata.description: Which real source fed each block. 'derivatives' should record carry.data_status (binance_public vs bybit_public) rather than a fixed string, since the live engine genuinely switches sources on failure.

missing_data_flags.description: (existing pattern) Maps to snapshot() 'quality.optional_missing' -- the live engine already produces this exact concept (list of optional fields that failed to fetch this run), reuse it directly rather than inventing a new flagging mechanism.

return_pct.description: (existing at 24h only, needs normalization) crowding.price_change_24h_pct covers 24h; 1h/4h/7d are trivial derivations from already-fetched closes, no new fetch.

atr_pct.description: (existing, renamed from atr14) The live engine stores ATR as a percentage of price (atr_pct_1h / atr_pct_4h), not an absolute value. Renamed to match reality rather than re-deriving an absolute figure that isn't otherwise needed.

realized_vol.description: (existing, reuse instead of recomputing) Use volatility.atr_percentile_1d + volatility.bb_width_pct_4h together rather than a separately-computed stdev-of-log-returns -- see 'Duplication removed' in DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md.

trend_state.description: (existing, enum corrected) EMA20/EMA50 + breakout based, matches structure.state / structure.state_1d exactly. Enum values corrected from the original uptrend/downtrend/range placeholder to the real live values.

structural_levels.description: Superseded for 4h/1d by the richer top-level 'structure' block above (which includes operational support/resistance, not just swing points). Kept here only for symmetry across timeframes where the top-level block doesn't apply (e.g. 1h-only fields).
